name: @purothemes/plugin-build
description: Release tooling for WordPress plugins: variant zips with PHP overlays, vendored-asset sync, version stamping, POT generation, publishing to the update server, and staging the free build into WordPress.org SVN. All product specifics come from the consuming plugin's build-config.mjs.

scripts.test: node tests/generic.test.mjs && node tests/sync-vendor-assets.test.mjs && node tests/publish-wporg.test.mjs
